question: The 23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine (PPSV23) is recommended for all adults aged 65 years and above, as well as for younger adults with chronic lung disease, diabetes mellitus, or asplenia, to prevent invasive pneumococcal disease.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. PPSV23 (Pneumovax) is recommended for all adults ≥65 years AND for younger adults with risk conditions including chronic lung disease (COPD, asthma), diabetes mellitus, chronic heart failure, asplenia (functional or surgical), chronic renal or liver disease, and immunocompromised states. The vaccine significantly reduces invasive pneumococcal disease risk in these groups.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. PPSV23 is indicated for: (1) all adults ≥65 years; (2) adults 19–64 with chronic cardiopulmonary disease, diabetes, chronic liver/renal disease, asplenia, or immunocompromising conditions. It covers 23 serotypes responsible for ~85–90% of invasive pneumococcal disease.
